confirmed.name: The Nubian News
confirmed.whyMatch: The Nubian News's own site hosts a self-published PDF archive of full back issues under assets/pdf/. Downloaded Vol. 6 No. 1 (Jan. 7, 2022), a complete 12-page issue of the actual newspaper -- masthead, layout, articles, ads all present. Title, city (Trenton), and publisher (Kamau Kujichagulia, per site) match the dankyNote exactly; this is an active, still-publishing paper (yearCeased null).
confirmed.caption: The Nubian News, Vol. 6 No. 1, Jan. 7, 2022 -- full 12-page issue PDF from the paper's own online archive
confirmed.notes: Archive page (thenubiannews.com/archive) lists dozens more issues from 2020-2023 (V4-V6) available at the same assets/pdf/ path if additional issues are needed.
confirmed.verdictReason: Local file is a valid PDF (%PDF-1.3, 28.1 MB, 12 pages, well-formed trailer/EOF). Extracted page 1 text shows the actual masthead 'The Nubian News / Loving the Black Perspective', with 'Volume 6 / Number 1 / FREE / January 7, 2022' and the paper's own contact block (nubiannews@thenubiannews.com, www.thenubiannews.com, (609) 858-2777 -- a Trenton-area 609 number). Body content is Trenton local news (fire at Rusling St. and Division St., Trenton) and is bilingual English/Spanish, matching the record's 'New Jersey's only African-American-Hispanic news source' and languages 'English/Some spanish'. City (Trenton), title, and era (yearCeased null = still publishing, 2022 issue) all match publication id 40. Source URL https://www.thenubiannews.com/archive returns HTTP 200 and is the publisher's own site. This is a primary issue of the named paper, not a mention, catalog record, or similarly named title.

confirmed.caption: MEDIC News, vol. 1, no. 1 — 8-page newsletter, Newark, NJ. Gus Heningburg Collection, Charles F. Cummings New Jersey Information Center, Newark Public Library.
confirmed.verdictReason: localFile is a valid 8-page PDF (455 KB, PDF-1.5, all pages non-blank with images and OCR text). PDF metadata: title 'MEDIC News vol. 1 no. 1', creator Internet Archive, keywords link to https://archive.org/details/Heningburg166. Source URL returns 200; IA metadata gives title 'MEDIC News vol. 1 no. 1', collections npl-heningburg / newarkpubliclibrary, described as the Minority, Economic, Development and Cultural Enterprises, Inc. newsletter. Page text is the publication itself, not a mention: masthead reads 'Medic / Vol. 1 / Issue 1 / MEDIC Enterprises, Inc. / Minority, Economic, Development, Industrial and Cultural Enterprises, Inc.', with the address 287 Washington Street, Newark, New Jersey. Content is Newark minority economic development (MEDIC Press, Tri-Cities Limo, Secretary of Commerce Stans visit to Newark, NJ minority enterprise program). confirmed.name: Captain Africa
confirmed.whyMatch: IA item 'Captain Africa: the battle for Egyptica' (Trenton, NJ: Africa World Press, 1992) — IA metadata description states it is a reprint 'Originally published: Somerville, N.J.: African Prince Productions, 1990.' Same title, same creator work (Dwayne J. Ferguson / African Prince Productions), matching NJ publisher and era in dankyNote (Glen Ridge/Somerville, African Prince Productions, 1992-1994). Downloaded the item's cover thumbnail image (full-text PDF is lending-restricted).
confirmed.caption: Cover of 'Captain Africa: the Battle for Egyptica,' the 1992 Africa World Press reprint of Dwayne J. Ferguson's Captain Africa comic, originally published by African Prince Productions of Somerville/Glen Ridge, NJ.
confirmed.verdictReason: File 112-captain-africa-cover-thumb.jpg (180x288 JPEG, non-blank, mean 108/stddev 53) shows the actual cover of 'Captain Africa: The Battle for Egyptica' by Dwayne J. Ferguson. IA metadata for captainafrica00dway confirms Africa World Press, Trenton, N.J., 1992, originally published Somerville, N.J.: African Prince Productions, 1990. Title, creator, publisher (African Prince Productions) and NJ city (Somerville, listed as an alternate city in the entry's historicalNotes) all match; era is within the 1990-1994 window. Caveat: this is the collected graphic-novel edition, not a numbered issue of the 1992-1994 comic serial, so it is an edition artifact rather than a single issue cover. It is a primary artifact of the named title, not a mention, catalog record, or different work.

High-resolution (4717x3657) auction-house photo shows actual magazine covers/spines, not a catalog record or mention.
confirmed.caption: A lot of 28 issues of Word Up! magazine (1987-1997), the Paramus, NJ hip-hop teen magazine, photographed for a 2022 Sotheby's 'Art and Influence of Hip Hop' auction.
confirmed.verdictReason: File 114-word-up-sothebys-lot.jpg (4717x3657 JPEG, non-blank) is an auction-house photograph of a physical fan of Word Up! magazine issues; the top copy is legibly the 'PREMIERE ISSUE' with Run-DMC cover, July/August 1987, No. 1, and later issues show the Word Up! '!' logo spines. Sotheby's lot page confirms 28 issues spanning 1987-1997 from founding editor Gerrie Summers' personal collection. confirmed.name: Rap Masters: Reader's Choice

Rap Masters was published by Faces Magazines of Paramus, NJ (sister publication to Word Up!), matching city and 1990-founding era. Falls within WHi holdings window (Mar 1992-July 1994) noted in Danky entry 5049.
confirmed.caption: Rap Masters magazine cover, November 1992 issue, published by Faces Magazines, Paramus, NJ.
confirmed.verdictReason: Local file 135-rap-masters-nov1992.webp is a valid WEBP (RIFF/VP8X header, 480x640, non-blank, stddev ~55-69 per channel) and is byte-identical in size (71,664 bytes) to the live source URL (HTTP 200, image/webp). The image shows an actual physical copy of the magazine with the full 'RAP MASTERS' masthead and the cover date 'NOVEMBER 1992' plus cover price, Kris Kross cover feature, and 'Hip-hop style for the '90s' cover line. This is the issue itself, not a mention, catalog record, or lookalike title. Era matches pubId 135 (founded 1990, still active; Danky entry 5049 records WHi holdings Mar 1992-July 1994, which brackets Nov 1992). NJ tie is established by the publisher of record (Word Up! Publications / Faces Magazines, Paramus and River Edge, NJ) rather than by text visible on the cover -- the only weakness, but the title, publisher lineage, and date are otherwise unambiguous.

rejected.name: Right On! (second issue)
rejected.reason: Correct title but wrong place and era. localFile 95-right-on-1977-v6n4.pdf is a genuine 75-page scan of Right On! vol. 6 no. 4, February 1977, editor Cynthia M. Horner. However its masthead reads 'published monthly by Laufer Publishing Company, 7060 Hollywood Blvd., Hollywood, California 90028.' Per the record's own Danky note, Right On! was published in Hollywood 1971-1982 and only moved to Cresskill, NJ in April 1983. This issue therefore documents the California era and is not evidence of the New Jersey publication.
